### THE COVER KEY HAS THREE SHAPES -- this is the reusable finding
  1 catalog `id`        projected ContentCatalog items
  2 href basename       id and basename are DIFFERENT strings (`cloud-az104-ch01` vs
                        `az104-ch01-prerequisites`); art existed under the name code never asked for
  3 slug of the title   the 3 Projects cards: curated in Firestore with ONLY {title, desc}, no id and
                        deliberately NO href so they cannot lie about being openable
Tried in order, icon only if all three miss. Covers resolve by URL GUESS + onerror, NEVER a manifest
fetch -- covers/manifest.json stays hub-only so hub-registry-audit.js:468 (one FAIL per orphan
cover, and it IS the deploy gate) never fires. Item art in its own dir: `zero-to-python` is already
both a catalog id AND a hub cover key.

### FOUR ROUNDS, AND EVERY WRONG TURN WAS A MEASUREMENT ERROR
- Diagnosed from DOM counts 3x. `onerror` REPLACES the element it fails on, so "never requested a

- Told the operator 27 covers were mismapped. FALSE -- 39 requested, 39 loaded, 0 missing.

### BUG-083 -- 30 REAL STUDENT UIDs were one `git add` from being committed
functions/uids.json, untracked and NOT gitignored. Never actually committed (verified: 0 commits
in git log --all). Archived + ignored; sweep generalised to
_tools/eduscan/untracked-secret-scan.sh. The dangerous set is UNTRACKED **AND NOT IGNORED** --
invisible to scanners that read tracked files AND to those that read ignored ones.

### Standing hazards
- ONE clean pass + ONE clean fail is not evidence. Try the near-miss and the ABSENT value.
- A guard that cannot fail is not a guard. Ask what input makes the condition false.
- Three of my own fixes reopened the bug they closed. Suspect every guard added for KINDNESS.
- Backticks in `git commit -m` are shell substitution. Ate text three times. Use -F.
